# The Boy and the Deep

*Osmund fears the day Robin decides he is old enough to find out what is in the deep channel. He asks you to put down one of the great crocos of the Undercut, and to tell Robin what you saw.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Osmund](../npcs/osmund.md) |
| Level | 45 |
| After | [Across After Dark](../quests/osmund_across_after_dark.md) |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 1 Elite [Undercut Croco](../monsters/undercut_croco.md)
2. Talk to [Robin](../npcs/robin.md)

## Rewards

- 15,170 EXP
- 900 mesos
- [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +150 standing with [Osmund](../npcs/osmund.md)
